name: probo
description: Analyse en masse de candidatures : vérification de la nature des documents, puis scoring d'adéquation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @probo/shared" "npm run dev -w @probo/api" "npm run start -w @probo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @probo/shared && npm run build -w @probo/api && npm run build -w @probo/web
scripts.test: npm run coherence && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
